en: The image shows a stylized postcard featuring the Olympic rings at the top, a branch with leaves and berries, and an aerial or map-like view of a large complex, likely an Olympic Village. The text below is in Czech and welcomes guests to the Olympic Village. The postcard references the XI Olympiad in Berlin 1936 and is signed by the Reich Minister of War von Blomberg and Dr. T. Lewald, President of the Organizing Committee.
